name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches the untimed 'also take the key', Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) and Existence(target_picked_up) cover the conditional and unconditional box requirements, and Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) keeps the 'Then' order. All clauses are hard, as the task states them without a preference cue. The compiler's redundancy note on RespondedExistence is harmless because the task states that clause.

texts: If the agent moves the ball, it must also take the key (no timing given, so the key may come before or after the ball is moved).
If the agent moves the ball, it must then pick up the box in the other room.
The box is picked up only after the agent has taken the key.
The agent must eventually pick up the box in the other room.
